a: An infinite `perforations` `holeRadius` draws no holes at all, where the `perforated` shape holds it to the box
`aqua` and `metal` tint and darkness mixes outside 0..100 produce invalid `color-mix()`, and those gradient stops turn black
A negative `rivets` `radius` writes negative `rx`/`ry`, so no rivets draw
`sunbeams` angle jitter can push a beam across 90°, flipping its lean or stretching it to ±1e16
b: Aqua and Metal pass unclamped tint/darkness percentages into `color-mix()`, which rejects them and drops the stop's color
Adjacent bevel bands overlap by one sample, so every seam double-paints the translucent bevel fill
Woodgrain places knots at fixed viewBox coordinates while its grain lines follow the outline's region
`irregularity: Infinity` (and `cornerCompensation: Infinity`) reads as 1, not the default, in the perimeter-warping effects
A non-finite entry in `range` silently removes the whole effect
Perforations accepts `holeRadius: Infinity`, producing infinite ellipse radii
